Compare population and area weights

Source: R/pks_compare_weights.R
pks_compare_weights.Rd

Districts that were split had to be divided between their successors, by population (default) or by area. pks_compare_weights() puts both versions of a harmonized panel side by side, so you can see where and how much a result depends on that choice. Merged and unchanged districts are the same under both weights.

Usage

pks_compare_weights(data, other = NULL)

Arguments

data

A harmonized tibble from pks_get() (not harmonize_to = NULL), with population or area weights.

other

NULL (default) to download the same years, offences, boundary and data version with the other weights, or that panel itself, for example when you have it already or work offline.

Value

A tibble with one row per year, district and offence key: year, ags, region_name, offence_key, estimated (split in at least one of the two panels), cases_population, cases_area, difference (area minus population), relative_difference (difference / cases_population), hz_population and hz_area (recomputed with pks_rates()). A message summarizes how many rows differ.

Deutsch

Stellt eine harmonisierte Tabelle mit Bevölkerungs- und mit Flächengewichten nebeneinander. Die Gewichte unterscheiden sich nur bei geteilten Kreisen; so lässt sich prüfen, wie stark ein Ergebnis von dieser Annahme abhängt. other kann die Tabelle mit den anderen Gewichten liefern, sonst wird sie mit denselben Jahren, Straftaten, demselben Gebietsstand und derselben Datenversion geladen.

See also

Other analysis: pks_rates(), pks_validate()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
d <- pks_get(years = 2005:2010, offence = "total")
w <- pks_compare_weights(d)
w[abs(w$relative_difference) > 0.01, ]
}
